concept.hr: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK: potvrda je redni broj + 1, jer SYN zauzima jedan broj
concept.en: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK: the ack is seq + 1, because the SYN takes one number

summary.hr: Klijent A i poslužitelj B usklađuju početne redne brojeve X i Y u tri poruke. Zašto B potvrđuje X+1, a ne X, i zašto su četiri koraka tri poruke.
summary.en: Client A and server B agree on initial sequence numbers X and Y in three messages. Why B acknowledges X+1, not X, and why four steps are three messages.
